description: Election Commission - W. P. Kumara De Silva was elected as Vice Chairman of the Hikkaduwa Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman of the Hikkaduwa Urban Council, which is a matter directly related to electoral processes and local government elections under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of an elected official to fill a position that became vacant due to a previous appointment, falling under the category of election results and declarations.
